meaning:
ἀριθμέω, -ῶ
[in LXX for סָפַר pi., פָּקַד pi., etc. ;]
to number (esp. for payment, MM, see word): Mat.10:30, Luk.12:7, Rev.7:9.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: but the very hairs of your head are all numbered.
But the very hairs of your head are all counted. Therefore don’t be afraid. You are of more value than many sparrows.
After these things I looked, and behold, a great multitude, which no man could count, out of every nation and of all tribes, peoples, and languages, standing…
